# `pacvamp channel pin`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp channel pin [--force] <ID>`

Pin the Arch mirror to a snapshot

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The snapshot id, such as 2026-09-03T06

## Flags
- **`--force`** — Pin even if the snapshot never reached rc or stable
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
